title: fix(control-ui): restore rail snapshots for large rosters and Pages
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the compact Control UI rail losing its warm-reload snapshot with large session rosters or retaining the previous view after visiting Pages. The cold-load campaign observed lists filling at about 4.25 seconds after a signed-in dashboard deep-link reload, shifting the selected row.

## User Impact

Returning operators retain their visible rows, pins, selected view, and display identity while the Gateway reconnects. Connection status and mutation permissions still come from the live connection. No configuration or server-data migration is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Two existing gates prevented the sidebar snapshot from being refreshed:

- Its embedded routing roster accepts at most 200 rows, but capture copied the entire live result. Valid owner-first results can include up to 60 additional owned rows, and pagination can grow the window further. Validation then rejected the entire sidebar snapshot. Capture now applies the existing roster bound; validation uses the same constant.
- Pages readiness waited for the inactive Sessions roster, which is cleared when Pages becomes active. Pages now waits for its dashboard catalog instead. Retry-pending reads retain the snapshot; terminal errors render live but cannot replace the last good cached catalog.

The existing snapshot remains the sole cache owner. Its visible rows and pins are retained separately from the bounded routing roster. Production LOC delta: **+6 net** (9 added, 3 deleted across four production files). The growth enforces the existing bounded-cache contract; the change removes the unrelated Pages readiness dependency and the validator's duplicate magic number.

## Evidence

Synthetic signed-in reload, 240-row roster, held hello, delayed counts and plugins:

| Measurement | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Session rows before hello | 0 | 10 |
| Rail entries before hello | 2 of 3 | 3 of 3 |
| Recorded sidebar state changes through reconciliation | 4 | 0 |
| Pages view | Previous Sessions snapshot retained | All 26 navigation entries restored; 0 state changes |

The candidate's selected rail box remains `{x: 7.5, y: 272, width: 36, height: 36}` before hello and after reconciliation in both views. The pre-fix producer comparison and candidate ran with the same fixture. These measurements establish the reproduced failure modes; they are not a new live Team measurement. All attached images contain synthetic data only.

Validation:

- Hetzner Crabbox `cbx_4674b4b48013`, run `run_9d154073a604df74100232502b6ee3f0`: both delayed-hello E2E cases pass, plus the pre-fix visual comparison. E2E runner wall time: 35.79 s for both cases (11.5 s test bodies); the real document reload, IndexedDB write/read, and browser geometry require this boundary. Equivalent command: `pnpm test ui/src/e2e/sidebar-cold-load.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` with the UI E2E config.
- Snapshot admission regression: old producer returns null for 240 rows; candidate passes. Five model tests pass, runner wall time 2.65 s (`pnpm test ui/src/components/sidebar-snapshot-model.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` equivalent runner).
- Snapshot lifecycle: 21 tests pass. Rail unit tests: 26 pass, including after the Pages readiness change.
- Independent autoreview: no accepted P0–P2 findings.
- Exact-head CI is green on `0f3a9753f981ec2e10f0877d1587e3c667b1c31d` ([run 38175357152](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38175357152)). The full UI run and baseline comparisons are recorded below. No merge requested.

Infrastructure: Testbox `tbx_01m4p2d8ag9cyhv4tepd6sxnn9` had no runner after 15 minutes and was stopped. AWS quota pressure left an unsuitable 2 GB fallback, which was released. Hetzner provided the browser proof. Its initial image needed the current Playwright Chromium installed before the tests could execute.

Initial CI found test-helper lint errors (nullable IndexedDB rejections, a shadowed parameter, and event-property assignments); all are fixed. Other reported failures on those runs were fail-fast cancellations. Hetzner `cbx_aff1f895717c`, run `run_0056248a003aeca4457c21b8ab5049c9`, passed scoped typed lint and both E2E cases, including the failed-catalog case (36.67 s E2E wall time).


## Final-head full UI validation

Full command: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts` on final head `0f3a9753f981ec2e10f0877d1587e3c667b1c31d`. Hetzner `cbx_0e02f1a5c614`, run `run_8765cd2e3ffa6875a2eceac10922c944`: **3,323 passed, 45 failed, 3 skipped**; 726 files passed, 16 failed, 1 skipped; 7,861.26 s wall time. Both sidebar cold-load cases passed in this full run. Removing only the failed-catalog capture guard also reproduced its regression before the full run (`L16_ERROR_REGRESSION_PROVEN=1`).

One additional suite failed before running because WebKit was missing from the lease: `ui/src/pages/workboard/workboard-native-bundle.e2e.test.ts`. After installing WebKit, its **2 tests passed** on the unchanged head in 40.74 s, same lease, run `run_5ccfb7a98f8581d5bfeb5a61a4379d05`.

All **45 behavioral failures predate this PR**. A two-worker replay of all 16 originally failed files on the unchanged PR head produced the identical 45-case failure set (42 passed, 45 failed; 836.38 s): Hetzner `cbx_2b0cc8500b72`, run `run_f00502ec098d8902cbad4898e43714a0`. Replaying those exact 45 cases on this branch's original base `ca3798a38171b430162daa793425c7dd37111568` reproduced every one, with no case-set difference (45 failed, 40 unselected; 683.70 s): Hetzner `cbx_3006c510fa2a`, run `run_dd51fc43f0ce296065569188f00073ce`.

A separate current-main comparison at `48b2ccd28567c3e5f554cde97752511642c4fbf0` ran the same 16 files: **83 passed, 4 failed**, 460.47 s, Hetzner `cbx_c5467d60c8ff`, run `run_378d63c8f03618ebe8c13ba34a2737f8`. Main has since received transcript/rail fixes (`84fb3196ed56`, `b73d6bf0a600`) and the reconnect fixture fix (`b17443fb0fb3`). The 41 cases passing there are not claimed fixed by this PR.

The four still failing on current main are collaborator scroll persistence, the QA automation private-mutation POSIX boundary, retained-table overflow affordances, and sidebar roster filtering. These are outside the snapshot change; the original-base replay establishes the same boundary independently of newer main fixes.

The final-head changed-file gate passed formatting, all 11 core test type graphs, UI typecheck, and the earlier guards, then stopped at the existing dead-export scan. Its **71 distinct reported export entries all also appear on current main**, with zero PR-only entries; the same scan was executed in the main comparison. The gate is reported as failed, not green. Exact-head GitHub CI is green. All lane-owned leases have been released; no live Gateway or real account was used.
